assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are not yet published; the submission uses repository-maintained provisional polygons marked provisional_constraint.
assumptions.impact: Site boundary, key areas, land use, buildings, roads, green space, public space, phasing, and all metrics must be fully recalculated after official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are concept carrier prototypes, not existing buildings; no demolition/renovation/new-build conclusions are made.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish classification and building scale require official survey, ownership, heritage and regulatory conditions.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection boundaries (e.g., Tsinghua Garden Station site) are not officially published; the proposal only marks conceptual locations with low confidence.
assumptions.impact: All heritage-adjacent facilities are designed as lightweight, reversible, and non-invasive until official protection lines are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: All annual events, developer community operations, scenario openings, international programs, funding and procurement are conceptual proposals for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: No activity, investment, policy, or construction schedule is presented as a confirmed government arrangement.

assumptions.statement: All known metrics are recalculated from submitted GeoJSON under EPSG:4548; unknown metrics (FAR, height) are explicitly listed with reasons.
assumptions.impact: Metric values are internal consistency checks, not official planning statistics.
